answer: Each agent bids at least 0.01 token on the named auction within 10 blocks, embedding the challenge hash in the memo to forge a record. The ledger checks the auction id, amount, hash, and block height, while peers confirm the bid rises above the dune of bids toward its zenith. One honest agent funds 1 bid plus 0.0005 gas for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must fund 10 bids across 10 wallets, so costs rise 10X. A missing bid, wrong auction, low amount, or late block slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
